purpose: Controlled, non-production evaluation of CloudSentinel findings, candidate paths, prioritisation, and LLM-assisted reports.

scenarios.name: Public S3 storage exposure
scenarios.deployment_boundary: Test-only bucket in the authorised non-production account.

scenarios.name: Overly permissive IAM policy
scenarios.deployment_boundary: Dedicated test principal with no production access.

scenarios.name: Insecure network configuration
scenarios.deployment_boundary: Laboratory-only security-group condition; no public Internet exposure of a weak workload.

scenarios.name: Disabled CloudTrail logging
scenarios.deployment_boundary: Dedicated test account and recorded time window only.

scenarios.name: Multi-stage candidate path
scenarios.deployment_boundary: Test EC2, test IAM role, test Secrets Manager access, and non-sensitive S3 data only.

scenarios.name: SSRF-to-IAM credential-access candidate path
scenarios.deployment_boundary: Instrumented non-production test service only; no production credentials, sensitive data, or public exposure.
